Powering the Markets: The Chinese Colossus
On Tuesday February 10, the Norwegian-American and Hellenic- American Chambers of Commerce held their tenth annual joint shipping conference in the New York Helmsley Hotel. This year's conference entitled "Powering the Markets: The Chinese Colossus," focused specifically on the economic, financial and legal factors within China. China is fueling shipping demand across the entire industry.
